question.text:
Paragraph: $$ \mathrm{RCONH}_2 \text { is converted into } \mathrm{RNH}_2 \text { by means of Hofmann bromamide degradation. } $$
In this reaction, $R \mathrm{CONHBr}$ is formed from which this reaction has derived its name. Electron donating group at phenyl activates the reaction. Hofmann degradation reaction is an intramolecular reaction.Question: Which is the rate determining step in Hofmann bromamide degradation?

solution.text: The rate determining step is probably elimination of $\mathrm{Br}^{-}$to form isocyanate because it is slower step of given conversion.
